descriptions.d18c_sparkle_init_8012b870: Load the "water sparkle" mesh node into +28 and the water level setting into +72, show the node, allocate 10 elements, place it at the origin rotated a quarter turn about z, and give each element flag 0, a 30 x 30 size, opaque alpha and a start time up to 1023 ticks before the current engine tick.
